text_block_list.text:
The turbulent three years I raced through 
alongside Red Desire have come to an end.
Eventually—

"The Saint crosses the sea, and the tale 
enters a new phase."

A door has finally opened before Red 
Desire. —Her challenge for the Breeders' 
Cup.

A world-class sanctuary where only the 
chosen elites gather. A long-cherished 
dream that everyone in Japanese racing 
yearned for.
The fated land where the Saint must stand.
(WOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Can she reach them?! Can she make it?! 
The challenger from Japan! Red Desire is 
still holding in fourth place!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... *pant*... *gasp*...!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(My body feels so heavy... After 
overcoming countless trials, I'm just one 
step away from reaching it, and yet—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...That was indeed the case.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I had you... someone who believed in me, 
always, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
――I must overcome this trial. In order to 
reach "that place" we aimed for 
together――!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Red Desire surges forward! The Crimson 
Maiden breaks clear from the outside all 
at once!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She closes in from behind! She crosses 
the finish line in first place—!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Red Desire has finally reached the 
pinnacle of the world—!!"
(WAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—gh.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —...Ngh, I took the win—...!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This... this praise is the brilliance I've 
been searching for all this time—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming countless trials, never giving 
up, continuing to run...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The supreme blessing bestowed only upon 
Saint Red Desire—...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah... I can't stop...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The Saint's power overflows without 
end...—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: From here on, once again, this world will—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: It is being filled with light—!

Red Desire's soul rejoices, overflowing, 
and spreading across the world.
And so, Red Desire conquered the BC, and—

She was showered with overwhelming praise 
from both home and abroad... from people 
across the entire world.
And then, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Despite running such a fierce 
race, there are no abnormalities found.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It's safe to say she's fully recovered. 
Honestly... it's like a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ufufu... Thank you very much.

Just as expected... the shadow of the 
'Scarlet Wedge' had completely vanished 
from Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The many trials up until now, all the 
blessings gained from them... and the 
suffering.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Completely taming even that chronic 
affliction known as the 'Crimson Wedge'—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I have finally achieved it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: To the Saint, Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I shall continue to run across the world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"In order to expand the world where Saint 
Red Desire can truly shine—"

"Saint Red Desire continues to sprint 
tirelessly through this world today."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: We can finally see Desire run in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you win an overseas race with your 
juniors last month, too? You're 
practically a world-famous celebrity now!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, with that run making the impossible 
possible, she's completely captured the 
whole world's attention.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire! A peerless Umamusume who could 
overturn the very rules of this world, 
that's who!

text_block_list.name: Saint-Admiring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"You didn't let any hardship stop your 
stride; you just ran relentlessly down the 
path you believed in. Ran, ran, and ran!"

text_block_list.name: Saint-Admiring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"And then, she showed me a world no one 
had ever seen before."

text_block_list.name: Saint-Admiring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If you don't give up, you can achieve 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Saint-Admiring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Even someone small like me can become 
somebody! ...You made me believe that, 
just a little bit."

text_block_list.name: Saint-Admiring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I want to become like that, too. Just like 
you...—

text_block_list.name: Saint-Admiring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
To become an Umamusume who provides 
guidance—through running!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm finally getting to run in an overseas 
race! With Desire-san's teachings in my 
heart, I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, I'm still not quite 
confident in myself, but..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry. You have 
trained so diligently; the results will 
surely follow naturally.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, if... you still can't shake that 
anxiety――"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I shall bestow upon you the Saint's 
blessing. A blessing that will allow you 
to believe in yourself."

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Please! I beg of you...!!

Having conquered the BC with legs that 
showed no signs of slowing, Red Desire 
went on to triumph over challenge after 
challenge, both at home and abroad.

And now and then, in the haven where 
Manhattan Cafe guided her, Red Desire 
coaches and mentors her junior Umamusume.

Countless eyes filled with admiration and 
longing for her.

It was also—a seed of hope, passed down 
from Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Watching the girls you've taught and 
guided go on to achieve great things... is 
truly something precious, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
Isn't it tough balancing racing and 
coaching?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: No. This... this is my mission.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"To conquer the races with this life. And 
through that display, guide the Umamusume 
who will shine in future generations."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With these two wheels, this world— shall 
transform into the world where Saintess 
Red Desire ought to be.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Toward the wonderful world that I... and 
everyone who believes in me so strongly 
desire――!

The world will truly be reborn before 
long.

"That is the destiny of Red Desire and 
this world."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...There is one place I wish to visit 
with you."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember? It was here that we 
forged our solemn contract.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Nowadays, there are believers of Saint Red 
Desire all over the world. However...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You... you alone are my first, and my last 
soul resonator.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Through every hardship, they never let go 
of my hand."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even when my body was ravaged and I bled 
against the wedge... you still believed in 
the radiance sleeping within me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—That sincere devotion was the greatest 
and most blissful salvation for this soul.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I truly am a fortunate one.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
O heavens, O earth, O all of the world. I 
offer my gratitude to this very moment, 
the "now."

"At the end of running through, what I 
reached was— an unbroken chain of 
blessings. A light continuing eternally 
into the next world."

The true, palpable sensation of living 
life to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The tale of Saint Red Desire does not end 
here."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So that we may welcome the day this world 
turns into my realm, as the unchanging you 
and I—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>. Please, from here on out as 
well—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Let us go forth together.
choice_data_list: Yeah, to the ends of the earth!
Yeah, all the way to the end!

text_block_list.text:
"Saint Red Desire, and the companion who 
continued to believe in her."
May endless fortune bless their journey.
